title: cleistanthus pierrei
intro: Cleistanthus pierrei, commonly known as  "Qing Pi," is a traditional Chinese medicinal plant that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is used to treat a variety of ailments, including digestive issues, fever, and inflammation. The health benefits of Qing Pi include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving symptoms of respiratory issues, such as cough and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Qing Pi include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, anti-bacterial, and anti-oxidant properties.
